text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Aaargh, dammit! Running like 
this... I'll never reach them.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"An impact on par with winning the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe... We're nowhere near 
that level yet..."

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Tap~ Cheer up~ Things are looking up. They 
really are...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text: What more could I possibly do, though...

Throughout the summer, I strived for 
running worthy of the world stage that 
would satisfy the Lender. But...

"I just can't break through the wall. 
That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, stop pulling on me!

"I have brought someone who knows what 
lies beyond that wall. Someone who once 
shocked the world at the Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yo. Looks like you've been working hard, 
Tap Dance City.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Her running style's front-running, just 
like mine. Well, I've had my eye on her."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Katsuragi Ace...! Really?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this is...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so by "begging someone for help," 
you mean dragging them here by force?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I don't hate that passion of yours. 
If there's anything I can do, I'll gladly 
lend a hand."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
For the next Japan Cup, if you truly want 
to make the world gasp in awe, that is.
Katsuragi Ace smirked. Yes, that day—

Despite being the 10th favorite, Katsuragi 
Ace led wire-to-wire to win the Japan Cup, 
becoming the "World's Ace."

A brilliant run, leaving behind both 
Symboli Rudolf the "Emperor" and Mr. C.B. 
the "Free Spirit." She truly delivered a 
front-running performance full of soul.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you rushing all the way over here... 
That's the best!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ace, you of all people should know. 
There's still something missing in my 
running.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Tell me. On that day you were called the 
World's Ace, what were you aiming for, and 
how did you run?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind talking, but before that, 
tell me a bit more about yourself.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If their mindsets are completely 
different, their running won't sync up 
either.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Tap, what's your reason for aiming to win? 
Is it the same as mine, after all...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "Treason"?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Treason"? Revolt?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's that simmering, boiling rage 
towards those who look down on me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“You can't win unless you're blessed from 
the start.” For those who trap themselves 
in that mindset...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll make you all stare at my back! Is 
that the kind of drive pushing you forward 
too?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Letting them gaze upon your back, huh... 
If those are your feelings, then...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. Yeah, I've got it! But the back 
I want to show them is—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This back isn't meant for putting folks in 
their place. It's meant for pulling 
someone forward.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Leading from the front... Her back?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Behind me, I have a whole bunch of 
comrades. For their sake...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I just wanna pull them along. All the way 
to a place where they can feel safe. 
That's...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's my dream! My joy! My reason for 
living! That's why I do it. That's why I 
run.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"To repay those who believed in me and 
build a castle where I can live with the 
ones I love. That is my ambition!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I see. Not for the sake of rebellion, but 
for your benefactor and your comrades...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Then my case might be a bit different from 
yours. Not sure if it'll be much help, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Because Ace, the reason I chased 
you all the way from America is—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Because that was the back you showed me 
at the Japan Cup that day!"

That was truly the starting point of the 
dream. Back then, Tap Dance City was in 
America...

After witnessing Katsuragi Ace's heroic 
front-running and admiring her back, I 
came to this country.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No one can run like you except me, the one 
who's always chased after your back. And 
so—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
My current crew... Meeting these guys was 
all thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right, you're right. If Tap hadn't 
looked up to Ace-san...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
I never would've come to this country or 
met them. So she's a benefactor to all of 
us, huh?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Me... a savior...? A savior to everyone... 
you say...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa! You just went and saddled me 
with something completely crazy out of 
nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"All I did was chase my dream, running 
straight toward it, but..."
choice_data_list:
Even so, I suppose these things always 
find a way to connect.

Even so, I guess these things always 
connect to the future, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Being connected... Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Please lend your strength to your junior.
Please lend your strength to your junior.

text_block_list.text:
Riding the momentum, I push a little 
further. If only I could learn that 
legendary front-running style from her...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ace, what I'm aiming for might seem like a 
ridiculous dream to everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! I still believe this! I don't 
wanna throw their kindness into the 
gutter! I wanna create a place where we 
can all laugh together!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now, that dream is fading away... If I 
can't put on a performance that proves 
myself to the world, there won't even be a 
next time. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Please, Ace! Give me your front-running, 
that dazzling jewel of yours!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens... I refuse to let 
this banner be broken!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So you had this flag... snapped in two, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, yeah. That's true. Coming out from 
the boonies with nothing to my name...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
We can't just go home with our dreams 
crushed, can we? If you've got that kind 
of resolve, then...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Fine, Tap. It hit me. Right in the middle 
of my heart, with a bang."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
From today until the big day, I'll lend 
you a hand. As your senior!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much! That's why you're my 
idol!"

After persistently asking and pleading, I 
managed to get them to agree.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Tap. Starting today, we're doing 
thorough tandem runs. —I'll teach you 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What it truly means to break away and win 
against the world's best and two Triple 
Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Great! I'm counting on you, my Hero!
